item.description: Penn State University has reached an agreement with Matt Campbell to become the 17th head coach in Nittany Lions football history, pending approval of terms by the Board of Trustees’ Equity and Human Resources Committee. item.description: Pine Grove used a dominant first half and a balanced scoring effort to secure a 54–38 road victory over Minersville on Friday night. item.title: Frackville Business Group Plans to “Light Up” Town with Holiday Events, Fundraising
item.description: The Frackville Business and Professional Association (FBPA) is kicking off the Christmas season with a full slate of holiday activities designed to bring families together and raise money to upgrade the community’s Christmas light display. Since reorganizing in May 2023, the FBPA has grown to more than 35 member businesses and has made revitalizing Frackville’s holiday decorations one of its top priorities.
